set.body:
Pre-register the superiority court before implementation results can influence it.

Acceptance criteria:
AC-431-01: Publish a versioned machine-readable protocol covering scenario seeds, shapes, complete affines, motion trajectories, nuisance parameters, reference policy, masks, interpolators, repetitions, thread counts, stage boundaries, and execution order randomization.
AC-431-02: Register every metric with units, direction, aggregation, claim or diagnostic role, missing-value policy, positive practical superiority margin, and scenario-level non-inferiority margin.
AC-431-03: Define absolute gates plus separate comparative hypotheses for AFNI 3dvolreg, nifreeze, and FSL MCFLIRT without post-hoc endpoint or comparator selection.
AC-431-04: Co-primary endpoints are physical landmark displacement p95, corrected-image NRMSE, matched end-to-end elapsed time, and estimation-stage elapsed time. Required guardrails cover relative rotation, framewise-displacement error, boundary and temporal fidelity, edge preservation, ringing, and failure rate.
AC-431-05: Pre-register the independent sampling unit, required number of subjects or synthetic runs or the precision-based stopping rule, paired randomization, cluster-aware interval method, confidence level, multiplicity control, exclusions, scenario weights, and complete pass rule.
AC-431-06: Define both a common-resampler estimation court and a native end-to-end pipeline court so interpolation quality and estimator quality are not conflated.
AC-431-07: Record dataset checksums, provenance, license constraints, comparator digests or versions, hardware controls, JVM warm-up policy, receipt schema, and exact permitted claim language.
AC-431-08: The protocol rejects negated Euler columns, spacing-only coordinates, self-resampler truth, voxel or frame pseudoreplication, native tSNR or DVARS as accuracy truth, one-shot timing, silent skips, and retrospective margin changes.
